We wanted to bring back an OLD style of GN content that you all haven't seen in years, which is a vlog with our team as we tackle things in the office daily. For this one, we're trying to become more self-sufficient and collect tools -- including media duplicators, 3D printers, paper printers, and more -- to make things for our store as we continue to fund increasingly huge reviews and investigations. Our recent LG investigation and Steam Frame review content are funded by the behind-the-scenes print farm and media "factory" we're starting to run. Come along as we learn the processes and have some fun.
